title.purpose: Section h3; h2 sits between at 1.25rem.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, compact UI text.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Color, background, and shadow transitions at 160–220ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #6366f1; color: #fff; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7375f2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(160, 174, 192, 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 8px; background: #f8f9fb; color: #4a5568; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e9ebef; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(160, 174, 192, 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #4a5568; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #a0aec0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(160, 174, 192, 0.5); }

components.name: Level Chip
components.description: Pill tag for levels and filters; selected state deepens the tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1); color: #6366f1; font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.16); } .ds-chip.is-selected { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4); }

components.name: Mobile Nav Item
components.description: Row in the mobile overlay menu; active state is a flat lavender chip.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-radius: 14px; color: #45326f; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.79rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #352758; background: rgba(124, 104, 217, 0.08); transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(124, 104, 217, 0.16), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124, 104, 217, 0.18); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color: #261943; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(124, 104, 217, 0.22), rgba(124, 104, 217, 0.14)), rgba(241, 233, 255, 0.6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(123, 103, 219, 0.36); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: White card on the misty background, flat with a hairline border.
components.html:
B1 vocabulary

1,248 words in this level.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: Sora, Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2f2755; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #4a5568; }

components.name: Exercise Card
components.description: Signature practice card tinted with its exercise type's color pair (word typing shown).
components.css: .ds-exercise-card { width: 280px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #7A68D8; border-radius: 14px; background: #F2F0FF; text-align: center; } .ds-exercise-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #6B58C8; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .ds-exercise-label { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #2f2755; }

narrative.overview:
"The Night-Sky Atlas" describes the current look. It is an optional source of inspiration, not a required visual direction: new pages and features may take a different direction when that serves learners better.

FluentStellar is a visually engaging language-learning platform. Every word has a place in its CEFR level, and the interface helps learners see where they are, what is nearby, and how much remains. Hierarchy is clear and the feel is precise and structured, while color is used generously and with purpose: to identify sections, learning modes, and exercises, to signal state, and to make practice feel lively.

Today the palette pairs a deep violet range (night ink through nebula purple) for navigation, account surfaces, and dashboard figures with pale backgrounds, a bright indigo for many actions, and a distinct color pair for each exercise type. This palette is a starting point, not a closed set.

Density is moderate: reference pages (word pages, level lists, vocabulary tables) favor scannable rows and tight data, while practice screens give one card room to breathe. The system is light-only today.

Everything below describes the current implementation and offers flexible guidelines. Use judgment over rules when a different choice clearly improves the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Pale, cool backgrounds with white cards, mostly separated by hairline borders.
A multi-color palette: violets, indigo, blue, green, amber, and per-exercise pastels.
Sora headings over Manrope body text: geometric and confident.
Pill-shaped chips and indicators, with modest 6–10px corners on most other elements.
Each exercise type has its own color pair, used consistently wherever that type appears.

rules.name: The Constellation Guideline
rules.body: An exercise type's color pair identifies that type, so keep it consistent across its card, icon, selector, and result. New exercise types or learning modes can get their own new color pair.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Guideline
rules.body: By default, Sora is for headings and Manrope is for everything else. Body text, buttons, and dense data read best in Manrope.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Guideline
rules.body: Surfaces are mostly flat at rest, and stronger elevation usually belongs to overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) and state feedback. Use more depth where it clearly helps a surface.

dos: Do use color expressively: different accents for buttons, learning modes, exercises, interactive elements, and section identities.
Do introduce new complementary colors when they improve the interface, ideally as reusable theme tokens.
Do keep each exercise type's color pair tied to that type wherever it appears.
Do check that text and essential UI meet WCAG AA contrast, and pair color with text or icons for state.
Do reuse existing theme tokens (var(--primary), var(--border), var(--radius)) when one fits.
Do prefer hairline borders (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)) and tonal fills for separating resting surfaces.
Do use pill shapes (999px) for chips, badges, and progress tracks, and 8–10px corners for buttons, inputs, and cards, unless a component needs otherwise.
Do default to Sora for headings and Manrope for everything else.
donts: Don't use one accent color for conflicting meanings on the same screen.
Don't let the active navigation item look like a CTA button.
Don't assume the inactive dark tokens are a finished dark theme; the site is light-only today.
